project.name: SkillWeave Initiative 04 — Repo Cleanup and Lean Core
project.description: Structured repository cleanup with classification, preservation, and lean core definition aligned to future architecture

objectives.description: Catalog and classify all repository files with structured categories
Define lean core and establish structured archive for non-core assets

tasks.title: Build repository inventory scanner
tasks.description: Create a scanner that catalogs all files with path, type, last_modified, size_bytes, and suggested_category. Output to .skillweave/cleanup/inventory.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: Scanner processes entire repo directory tree
Each file entry has: path, type, last_modified, size_bytes, suggested_category
Output saved to .skillweave/cleanup/inventory.yaml
Respects .gitignore patterns
Handles 500+ files without performance issues

tasks.title: Build classification engine
tasks.description: Rule-based classifier that assigns categories (active-core, consolidation-candidate, legacy-valuable, deprecated, needs-review) based on file patterns, location, age, and naming conventions.
acceptance_criteria: 5 categories implemented: active-core, consolidation-candidate, legacy-valuable, deprecated, needs-review
Rules consider: file location, naming convention, age, reference patterns
Each classification has confidence score (high/medium/low)
Low-confidence items default to needs-review
Rules are configurable via YAML

tasks.title: Build archive manager
tasks.description: Tool for moving files to .skillweave/archive/ with metadata preservation. Supports move-to-archive and restore-from-archive operations.
acceptance_criteria: Moves files to .skillweave/archive/{category}/
Creates manifest entry with: original_path, category, rationale, date, reversible
Archive manifest is human-readable YAML
Restore function moves files back to original path
Manifest tracks all archive operations

tasks.title: Build duplication detector
tasks.description: Identify duplicated or highly similar logic across skills, prompts, and configurations. Report duplication with file pairs and similarity indicators.
acceptance_criteria: Detects similar file names across directories
Identifies overlapping content in skill definitions
Reports duplication with file pairs and similarity score
Suggests consolidation candidates
Output saved to .skillweave/cleanup/duplications.yaml

tasks.title: Build cleanup report generator
tasks.description: Generate human-readable cleanup report summarizing inventory, classifications, duplications, and recommended actions.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes: total files, per-category counts, duplication findings, action recommendations
Saved to .skillweave/cleanup/report.md
Includes reversibility info for all proposed actions
Human-reviewable before any destructive action
Markdown formatted with tables and summaries

tasks.title: Define lean core manifest
tasks.description: Document the minimal set of files needed for SkillWeave operation. Distinguish required, recommended, and optional files. Align with future architecture from Initiative 01.
acceptance_criteria: Lean core manifest lists all essential files
Files categorized as: required, recommended, optional
Non-core files are candidates for archive
Manifest aligned with Initiative 01 lifecycle model
Saved to .skillweave/cleanup/lean-core.yaml

tasks.title: Execute cleanup process on SkillWeave repo
tasks.description: Run the full cleanup pipeline: scan → classify → detect duplicates → generate report → review → archive non-core items. Human approval required before archiving.
acceptance_criteria: Full inventory generated
All files classified
Duplication report produced
Cleanup report generated and reviewed
Non-core items archived with manifest entries
No active functionality broken

tasks.title: Post-cleanup validation
tasks.description: Run full test suite after cleanup to verify no functionality was broken. Verify archive is complete and reversible.
acceptance_criteria: All existing tests pass after cleanup
Archive manifest is complete and valid
Restore function works for at least 1 archived item
Lean core files all present and functional
No unclassified files remain

assumptions.description: Repository can be classified with rule-based heuristics without deep code analysis
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Classification quality lower, more items in needs-review
assumptions.validation_method: Test classifier on 50 files, measure accuracy

assumptions.description: Archive structure does not interfere with active tools
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Tools may accidentally process archived files
assumptions.validation_method: Verify .gitignore and tool configs exclude archive

technical: No file deletion without human approval
All archive operations must be reversible
Cleanup must not break any active functionality
Must align with future architecture from Initiative 01

risks.mitigation: Full test suite after every archive batch
Conservative classification, human review for uncertain items

execution_recommendation.reason: 8 tasks, ~6 hours total, sequential pipeline with tool-building + execution
